bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'AUDIT=TOPIC_BUTTON_READ_ONLY\n'
printf 'WORKDIR=%s\n' "$PWD"
printf 'HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'BRANCH=%s\n' "$(git branch --show-current)"
printf 'STATUS_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git status --porcelain | wc -l)"
printf 'TOPIC_BUTTON_CANDIDATES_BEGIN\n'
find . -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname '*topic*' -o -iname '*button*' -o -iname '*post*menu*' -o -iname '*pin*' \) -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*' | head -n 65
printf 'TOPIC_BUTTON_CANDIDATES_END\n'
printf 'SERVICE_NAMES_BEGIN\n'
systemctl --user list-units --type=service --no-pager --plain 2>/dev/null | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|gateapp|telegram|userbot' | cut -c1-150 | head -n 25 || true
printf 'SERVICE_NAMES_END\n'
printf 'AUDIT_END=YES\n'
